The buttons lack mechanical definition, appearing fused. I agree with Severity 3.0.
3. Stylus Distortion (1.5): Minor geometric warp. Acceptable.
4. Texture Anomaly (2.0): Top-left button looks painted-on. Consistent with AI generation issues.

These defects indicate a clear AI-generated origin with noticeable structural inconsistencies.
